name: King Hugh
source:
King Hugh, first of his name, is King of the Lusanti. His once enlightened rule, has fallen into alcoholism and paranoia, especially toward his [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]eldest son[/url]. The King's hostility towards the MC is a mystery to most.

[In game description]
